name: Inside the Toy
original_name: インサイド・ザ・トイ
source: You wake up one day, only realizing to have been turned into a toy. In an attempt to reunite with your orphaned younger sister you go all out to become a human once again. However, along the way you come across an unexpected figure...
translation: You wake up one day, only realizing to have been turned into a toy. In an attempt to reunite with your orphaned younger sister you go all out to become a human once again. However, along the way you come across an unexpected figure...
